tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// buddha tsu ru ka'i skye ba brtag pa'i gdams ngag gzhung gsal byed dang bcas pa dri bral nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ rnam pa kun mkhyen ye shes can// thub dbang de la gus btud nas// rang gzhan skye ba brtag pa'i tshul// dri bral nor bu'i me long ngom// 'di la gsum/ rtsa ba dang gzhung rnying pa'i khungs dgod pa/ de'i gdams ngag lag tu blang ba'i tshul gsal bar bshad pa/ rtags kyi rim pa mtshon tshul lo// dang po ni/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud kyi le'u gnyis pa las/ oṃ buddha tsu ru ma tsu ru ke swā hā/ sku gdung dang bcas pa'i mchod rten nam rje btsun sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar bsnyen pa cho ga khri bzlas la/ de'i 'og tu ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa byas nas nyal ba'i dus su brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ bdag gang nas skyes par gyur/ gang du skye bar 'gyur zhes yid la bsams shing nyal na nam langs pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba dmigs par 'gyur ba the tshom med do// zhes bya ba ni rgyud kyi dum bu'o// ༈ /las dgu buddha tsu ru zhes pa la sogs pas skye ba brtag pa ni/ sku gdung dang bcas pa'i mchod rten nam sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i drung du pū dza bshams la/ de dag gis dkon mchog mchod de gso sbyong la gnas pas bsnyen par bya'o// gzhung las bsnyen pa'i cho ga khri bzlas la zhes 'byung yang 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas na gzhung nas 'byung ba'i las rnams grub pa yin no// zhes rje btsun grags pa'i rgyud 'grel las so// ༈ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag nyid nam 'chi ba dang*/ gang du skye ba la sogs pa brtag par 'dod pas 'di ltar bya ste/ oṃ buddha tsu ru ma tsu ru ke swā hā/ sku gdung dang bcas pa'i mchod rten nam/ rje btsun sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar bsnyen pa'i cho ga khri bzla/ de'i 'og tu ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa phul nas/

nyal ba'i dus su brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas shing rang khrus byas la gsol ba btab ste/ bdag gang nas skyes par gyur pa dang*/ gang du skye bar 'gyur pa bsam bzhin du nyal na 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba dran par 'gyur ba the tshom med do zhes 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig pu grub pa'i rgyud las gsungs so// de la man ngag ni 'di yin te/ sngon du mchod gtor chos ston tshogs bsags te/ de nas ma hā bo dhi'i lha gcig mdun du bzhugs la/ rang dang lha'i thugs kar tsandan dkar po'i thig le gsum gsum byas te/ ngag smra ba bcad la bsnyen pa 'bum tsho bcu gcig byas te/ de tshar ba dang las sbyor ni/ dkon mchog spyi dang shākya thub pa'i sgos kyi mchod pa gnyis bshams te dbul/ lha dang 'dom gang gis mi ring bar nyal/ sngags nus tshad bzla zhing bdag gang du ji ltar skye ba'i bya ba shes pa bstan du gsol zhes bsam zhing gnyid log par bya'o// nub dang po la ma rtogs na nub gsum du bya'o// des kyang ma rtogs na bsnyen pa bskyar te gdod las la sbyar na nges par rtogs par 'gyur ro// bod sgom la khyi gcig kho na rmi lam du byung nas bar chad yin nam zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas khyir skye ba yin gsungs/ der sdig sgrib sbyangs nas bltas pas mi gzhon nu gcig byung lo/ lha yul mthong bar rmi na lhar skye'o// dkon mchog gsum gyi rten rmi na skye ba der chos dang 'phrad par nges so// skye 'chi la sogs pa dus gsum gyi bya ba brtag pa dpal a ti sha'i man ngag las byon pa ltar bsdebs pa'o// zhes snar thang pa mchims nam mkha' grags kyis bsgrigs pa'i mngon rtogs brgya rtsa las byung ba'o// ༈ /oṃ buddha tsu ru ma tsu ru ke swā hā/ shākya thub pa lugs ma'am/ thang ka'am/ sder tsho'i mdun du maṇḍal bya/ pū dza dbul zhing mos gus byas te bzlas pa 'bum phrag gsum bskyel nas/ nya'am/ gnam stong ngam/

dus khyad par can la shākya thub pa'i zhal shar du bstan/ de'i mdun nam rtsar maṇḍal bya/ bzlas pa nus tshad gcig byas te nyal khar bdag skye ba snga ma gar skyes/ da gang du skye bstan du gsol zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsol ba btab nas mgo byang du bstan/ kha nub tu bstan/ rkang pa lhor bstan te seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal na gar skye rmi lam du ston to// de ma byung na nub gsum du bskyar ro// shākya rakṣi ta las brgyud pa'o// zhes dpal stag lung thang pa chen po bkra shis dpal gyis bsgrigs pa'i man ngag sna tshogs phan bde'i dpag bsam las byung ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ rten gyi gang zag so sor thar pa tshangs spyod dge bsnyen yan chad kyi sdom pa la gnas shing nyes ltung med pa/ byang chub kyi sems cung zad 'byongs pa/ dbang thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa/ khyad par thub pa'i dbang po'i bsgom bzlas la brtson cing bsnyen pa sngon du song ba zhig gis nyams su blang bar bya ste/ de la gnyis/ bsnyen pa dang*/ las sbyor ro// dang po ni/ gnas shin tu dben zhing gtsang la sdom pa dang dam tshig nyams pa sogs kyi skye bo'i rgyu 'grul tsam yang med pa'i sar/ bsam gtan gyi khang bur phyag dar bya/ spos chus chag chag gdab/ rang nyid kha nub tu phyogs pa'i mdun du stegs mtho bar sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel bzhugs nges pa'i mchod rten nam sku gzugs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rab gnas ma nyams pa zhig zhal shar du phyogs pas bzhugs su gsol/ de'i mdun du mar dkar gyi mar me rgyun mi chad pa gtso bor gyur pa'i mchod pa ci 'byor gtsang zhing bkod mdzes su bstar/ tsandan dkar po'i bdug spos btul/ rang khrus bya/ gos gsar pa gyon/ ku sha bkram pa'i stan la 'khod de mtshams dam par gcad/ theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong blang*/ sa gzhi byin rlabs sogs gnas brtan nam sman bla'i mdo chog las 'byung ba ltar ram bsdu na/

dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis/ deng 'dir khor yug gi sa gzhi 'di dag bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa lta bu phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pas mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ thams cad du yang sa gzhi dag /gseg ma la sogs med pa dang*// lag mthil ltar mnyam bai ḍūrya'i// rang bzhin 'jam por gnas gyur cig /phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing 'di dag tu lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa gzugs dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ reg bya la sogs pa rnam par dag cing yid du 'ong ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal sim byed pa'i// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /ces dang spro na mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs kyang brjod/ skyabs sems rgyas par bya ba'am/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs tshar grangs bsag cing blo rgyud dang 'gre nges par bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ de nas spos btul thal mo sbyar la 'dun pa rtse gcig pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// zhes sam spro na tshigs bcad tshang bas spyan drangs te/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i tshogs rnams sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul chen pos gshegs te mdun gyi rten dang dbyer med du bzhugs pa ni/

seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri padma dang zla ba'i gdan bkod pa phul du byung ba'i dbus su ston pa bcom ldan 'das sku mdog gser btso ma ltar 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ na bza' chos gos rnam gsum ngur smrig tu gsol ba/ sku mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba/ gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa/ thugs ting nge 'dzin sgo du ma la snyoms par 'jug cing ldang ba/ 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i tshogs kyis bskor te 'od kyi phung po'i klong na mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par gyur ces brjod cing gsal gdab/ yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga rgyas pa gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar ram/ bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i tshigs su bcad pa tsam gyis kyang rung ste phyag mang du btsal/ spyod 'jug ltar sems bskyed kyi sdom pa blang*/ de nas sku gzugs kyi thugs kar tsandan dkar po'i chab gtsang mas dri'i thig le gsum bkod la smra ba bcad de/ oṃ buddha tsu ru ma tsu ru ke swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags yi ge bcu gcig pa kho na bzla/ brgya phrag gam stong phrag re'i mtshams su/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pas bdag gang nas skyes par gyur pa dang*/ gang du skye bar 'gyur ba rmi lam du gsal bar lung bstan du gsol zhes lan gsum la sogs pa ngag gam yid kyis gsol ba gdab cing me tog 'thor ba re bya/ de'i tshe dmigs pa ni/ sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pas rjes su dgongs te thugs ka dang smin mtshams nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ lus dag pa'i shel ltar byas/ sems dug gsum gyi dri ma dang bral te lung bstan pa'i snod du gyur par bsam/ thun 'jog pa na slar yang yan lag bdun pa phul te gsol ba gdab/

thun mtshams su'ang rnam g.yeng gi bya ba dang*/ rnam par rtog pa mang po spangs te ltung ba bshags pa sogs dang bcas te phyag mang du btsal/ de lta bu'i rim pas 'bum phrag bzhi bzla bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ bsnyen pa grub nas cho ga gzhan sngar bzhin la/ nyal khar ru rta'i phye ma la/ oṃ mu tsi li swā hā/ oṃ mo ha ni swā hā/ oṃ danta li swā hā/ zhes bzlas pas bdugs la lag g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams la'ang sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas pas btab ste/ sku dang 'dom gang las mi ring ba'i sar mgo byang*/ kha nub/ rkang pa lhor bstan/ glo g.yas pa 'og tu phab ste seng ge'i nyal stabs dang*/ dge ba'i sems kyis snang ba'i 'du shes dang bcas te nyal bas zhag gsum mam bdun gyi tho rangs tshun chad du lung ston pa'i rmi lam rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ro// des ma grub na bsnyen pa dang las sbyor ji skad bshad pa bzhin lan gsum du byas pas mtshams med lnga byas pa ma gtogs mi 'grub pa mi srid par gsungs so// gsum pa ni/ tho rangs kyi dus su sangs rgyas kyis dngos su gsungs pa'am/ dge slong la sogs pa'i gzugs gzhan gyis bshad pa'am/ gang nas skyes pa dang*/ gang du skye bar 'gyur ba'i yul lam/ gzugs sam/ ming la sogs pas mtshon pa'am/ rmi lam du sngon dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba rjes su dran pa sogs gsal por byung na nam du'ang bslu ba med cing nges pa yin la/ brda rtags kyi sgo nas byung na dpyad shes par bya/ ngan song du skye ba'i mtshan ma byung na sdig ltung la bshags sdom dang bcas slar yang brtags pas mtho ris su skye ba'i mtshan ma 'byung ba dang*/ mtho ris su skye ba'i mtshan ma byung na bsag sbyang spyi dang*/ khyad par dag pa'i zhing sbyong ba'i ting nge 'dzin la goms pa lhur len pa dang*/ rten byin can gyi mdun du smon lam rgya cher gdab cing*/ bla ma dang dge 'dun gyi sde la'ang mthun 'gyur zhu ba sogs yid ches par bgyis te phyis brtags pas dag pa'i zhing du skye ba'i mtshan ma 'byung ba sogs rig pas dpyad la shes par bya zhing*/

gzhan yang rang gzhan gyi legs nyes bde sdug kyang rmi lam gyi skabs su lung bstan pa'i brda rtags ci rigs pa 'byung srid pas/ rmi lam brtag pa'i thabs dang gtam rgyud sogs las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin zhib mor gtan la 'bab pa dang*/ blang dor gyi gnas tshul bzhin du bgyis na phan bde'i dge legs kyi 'bras bu 'byin par gdon mi za'o// dri bral nor bu'i me long gis// rnam mang gzugs brgya mtshon pa ltar// rmi lam mtshan mas lung bstan tshul// 'dis kyang gzhan la phan par shog /ces pa'ang yig rnying gsal byed zhal shes dang bcas pa'i tshogs rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs te/ lag tu blang bde bar bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa dge legs su gyur cig/ //sarba dā maṅga laṃ su shre yantu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
